items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: He would pay musicians different things because different people were more important. That's exactly right. The trombone player he got $10 and I got $15 and when he gave it to me, he got mad. That was George Washington.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was in that. He was in Lucky Millinder's band.
